respaldo: Drawn arrow from Drone to 3rd Party; transcript states pilots load imagery into third-party software.
Drawn arrow from CloudWatch Event to Step Functions; transcript confirms CloudWatch event calls Step Functions.
Drawn arrow from Step Functions to Lambda; transcript states Step Functions consists of three separate Lambda functions.
Drawn line labeled API pointing from Lambda to 3rd Party; transcript mentions Lambda goes to third-party software via API.
Drawn arc from 3rd Party over to S3; transcript states images are taken from third party and stored in S3.
Drawn arrow from Lambda pointing up to S3; transcript states second Lambda takes images and stores them in S3.
Drawn arrow pointing from S3 down to Lambda; transcript describes Lambda taking S3 images and creating raster proxies.
Drawn arrow from Lambda to Database; transcript notes raster proxies are stored in local server database.
Drawn arrow from Server to Storage Gateway; transcript mentions mapping software hits Storage Gateway.
Drawn arrow from Storage Gateway to S3; transcript states on-premise software reads directly from S3 via Storage Gateway.
